titulo: Editing by agent: your reel editor
lead: forja-reel doesn't edit video: it interviews you and generates a skill of your own that edits, with your identity and a tested cut-and-pacing engine inside. In this lesson you open the published package, see what the child skill receives, and use the local pacing lint to fail a gap in the timeline before the render.
objetivo: understand what forja-reel generates and fail a pacing gap in the timeline with the local lint before rendering.

aprende.t: The four phases of the meta-skill: interview, diagnosis, generation, and debut
What goes into the child skill: the engine scripts, references, and your recipe
The pacing rule: no stretch longer than 4 s without a visual beat
What depends on an external service (transcription, b-roll) and what runs on your machine

hero_alt: Editing console with a jog wheel and keys, and a monitor with a timeline full of short colored clips.

secoes.titulo: From interview to the skill that edits
secoes.sub: Click each step. The first four belong to the meta-skill; the last one, to the skill it generates.

nos.detalhe: Eight blocks of questions about what you edit, how you appear on screen, colors, and style. Your answers become perfil.json.
Checks ffmpeg, Node, and HyperFrames and offers to install whatever is missing (opt-in). Warns you which parts depend on a service key.
Writes the child skill reel-edita-[brand]: SKILL.md, engine scripts copied as they are, references, and the recipe with your style.
Smoke test: the child skill is read and its scripts start (--help).
Cut, reading and treatment proposal, plan, build in HyperFrames, sound effects and QC, optional reviewer. This is the one you call with the raw video.

secoes.legenda: forja-reel in the package download/forja-reel.skill from the videos-edit-cria repository, commit d9a5137 (07/17/2026).

secoes.sub: The .skill is a zip. The block clones at the pinned commit, unzips, and lists the references and scripts.

blocos.conteudo:
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-fabrica/a6; rm -rf "$E"; mkdir -p "$E"; cd "$E"
git clone -q https://github.com/inematds/videos-edit-cria.git && git -C videos-edit-cria checkout -q d9a5137
unzip -q videos-edit-cria/download/forja-reel.skill -d skill
ls skill/forja-reel/references skill/forja-reel/assets/motor-scripts

abas.html:
skill/forja-reel/assets/motor-scripts:
captions.py
cut.py
fal-gen.py
islands.py
lint-timeline.py
make-sfx.sh
mix-sfx.py
verify-cut.py

skill/forja-reel/references:
01-entrevista.md
02-diagnostico-de-ambiente.md
03-geracao.md
04-modelo-skill-filha.md

The scripts in motor-scripts/ go into the child skill unchanged: the cut and the QC are the same for everyone; the style changes.

The SKILL.md itself warns: without a Groq key (an external service, free plan), the automatic cut and the repetition control don't work, because the word-level transcription comes from there. fal-gen.py generates b-roll on a paid service and only comes in if you turn it on. lint-timeline.py runs on Python alone, on your machine.

secoes.sub: Two 15 s 9:16 timelines in the kit: one with a beat every 1.5 s and another with a 6.5 s gap.

blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/formacao-cinema-ia-fabrica-v72/kit
cd ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-fabrica/a6; L=skill/forja-reel/assets/motor-scripts/lint-timeline.py
python3 $L "$K/exemplos/a6-ritmo/ritmo-ok.html" | grep -E "^Duração|ERROR"; echo "saída: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
python3 $L "$K/exemplos/a6-ritmo/ritmo-buraco.html" | grep -E "^Duração|ERROR"; echo "saída: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

abas.html:
Duração 15.00s · 1080x1920 · 10 beats · densidade média 5.33 beats/10s
saída: 0
Duração 15.00s · 1080x1920 · 5 beats · densidade média 2.67 beats/10s
ERRORS
L2.50 ERROR Buraco de 6.5s entre 2.5s e 9.0s — coloque um beat (snap/selo/B-roll) sincronizado com uma palavra-âncora
saída: 1

The first one passes with a warning (cut off here): the last 10 s window has only 5 s of video and always looks slow. The second one fails with the line and the exact time of the gap.

secoes.titulo: The excerpt that makes the difference
secoes.sub: Each beat is a fromTo on the GSAP timeline, at the second it comes in. The lint reads those times without opening a browser.

blocos.conteudo:
tl.fromTo("#b1", { opacity: 0, y: 40 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 2.5);
      tl.fromTo("#b2", { opacity: 0, y: 40 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 9);

secoes.sub: Package opened, gap found and fixed.

10 beats with saída: 0, and then ERROR Buraco de 6.5s entre 2.5s e 9.0s with saída: 1.

exercicios.texto: Copy ritmo-buraco.html to ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-fabrica/a6/meu-ritmo.html and add a beat between 2.5 s and 9 s (a new element and a fromTo at second 5.5).
exercicios.pronto: cd ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-fabrica/a6 && python3 skill/forja-reel/assets/motor-scripts/lint-timeline.py meu-ritmo.html | grep -c ERROR; echo "saída: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}" → 0 and saída: 0.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: What does forja-reel deliver in the end?
opcoes: An already edited reel, ready to publish.
A skill of your own that edits reels.
A list of 165 hooks per niche.
perguntas.explica: It's a meta-skill: it interviews you, checks the environment, and generates the child skill. The generated skill is the one that edits the video.

perguntas.p: The lint failed "Buraco de 6.5s". What's the right fix?
opcoes: Shorten the total length of the video.
Put a beat in the middle of the gap.
Remove the caption from the whole timeline.
perguntas.explica: The rule is no stretch longer than 4 s without a beat. Loosening the limit hides the problem the lint found.

perguntas.p: Without a Groq key, what stops working in the child skill?
opcoes: The automatic cut and the repetition control.
perguntas.explica: The word-level transcription that guides the cut comes from Groq. The lint and the render are local.

itens.texto: forja-reel generates your editing skill; it doesn't edit video.
cut, pacing and QC are the same scripts for everyone; the style is yours.
lint-timeline.py rejects more than 4 s without a beat, before the render.
